faq.subtitle: Everything you need before your first ride.

items.q: How do I start a ride?
items.a: Download the Blyzk app, create an account, then pick the nearest scooter on the map. Scan the QR code on the scooter and ride.

items.q: How much does a ride cost?
items.a: You pay per minute with transparent pricing shown in the app before you start — no subscription and no hidden fees.

items.q: Is it better for the city?
items.a: Blyzk rides are fully electric, so they skip fuel and tailpipe fumes. A cleaner way to move — without overpromising the planet.
Blyzk is available in Baghdad, Basra, Erbil, Mosul, Najaf, and Karbala — with clear ride and parking zones in the app.
Every scooter has dual brakes, LED lights, and GPS tracking. We recommend wearing a helmet and following local traffic rules.
